title: arifOS Claim Receipt
description: Canonical minimum proof object for every arifOS claim. No receipt = no canon. Implements the truth architecture: evidence layers L1-L4, authority binding, hash, timestamp, replay, falsification, dual human/agent surfaces. Forged 2026-07-08 under PROCEED (L4 + live kernel) YELLOW band. Complements memory-stack receipt.schema.json (L0-L6 provenance).

receipt_version.description: Version of this claim receipt format.

statement.description: Exact statement being claimed. Must be falsifiable.

evidence_layer.description: Truth level. L1=Ground Truth (sealed ratified immutable), L2=Verified State (live checked), L3=Cached State (previously known, may stale), L4=Inferred (reasoned, not proven). L4 NEVER triggers irreversible action.

issuer.description: Who issued (e.g. ARIF / F13, arifOS kernel, GEOX organ).

scope.description: Where it applies. Organs: AAA, GEOX, WEALTH, WELL, A-FORGE, VAULT999, arifOS, *

authority.description: Authority binding. Agents execute only within scope.

uri.description: Canonical source location (canon path, VAULT999 id, contract uri, etc).

content_hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source content at issuance. Proves no silent change.

timestamp_utc.description: When the source was authoritative (ISO 8601 UTC).

superseded_by.description: claim_id that superseded this, if any.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature or kernel seal ref over the claim fields.

replayable.description: Whether a deterministic replay command exists to re-verify.

verification.description: Verification envelope. Enables agent machine verification.

challenge_method.description: How to disprove: submit_counter_receipt, produce_newer_canon, etc.

correction_policy.description: Errors corrected by append-only counter-records. Never rewrite history.

falsification.description: Falsifiability and correction path. Humans gain trust via challenge rights.

verdict.description: Current status of the claim. Agents must respect this.

envelope.description: Optional transport envelope (_envelope) for cross-organ: session_id, constitutional_chain_id, actor_id, trace_id.
